candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show every checkout failure paired with a 500 from order:8000, while gateway /readyz stays 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only the order 500 propagation is established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently caused by upstream order service 500s on /v1/orders, seen in traces and logs with matching correlation IDs; gateway health endpoints remain 200. Order's own downstream cause is not yet observed.
